title: Torsvik & Cocks (2017) CEED6 Earth History and Palaeogeography model
citation: Torsvik, T. H., and Cocks, L. R. M., 2017. Earth History and Palaeogeography. Cambridge University Press, 317 pp. Model files: CEED6, http://www.earthdynamics.org/earthmodel/

license.name: not stated
license.statement: The download page and the accompanying data description carry no licence, only the book's copyright notice: \u00a9 Trond H. Torsvik and L. R. M. Cocks 2016.
license.note: No permission to redistribute is stated, so this model is kept for local use and is not published. publish=false keeps it out of the deployment bundle, and the deployed site therefore never offers it. Ask the authors before that changes.

publish_note: Local use only. scripts/pack_plates.py will pack it and a local server will serve it; deploy/pack_data.py skips it, so the public site does not have it.
relationship: An independent lineage from the EarthByte models, built on palaeomagnetism with longitudes tied to large igneous provinces and kimberlites. Its frame is the book's PM-HYBRID.
limitations: Reaches 540 Ma only. Distributed without a licence, so it stays local. The land polygons are the book's compilation rather than a coastline file.
